argv:
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
cat >"$HOME/.config/systemd/user/desktop-commander-remote.service" <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Remote Desktop Commander
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable desktop-commander-remote.service
printf 'DESKTOP_COMMANDER_SERVICE_INSTALLED\n'
intention: Install a persistent user-level Desktop Commander remote service on the Jetson using the official remote command so the remote terminal route can recover automatically after terminal closure or process failure.
consequence: Creates and enables one user systemd service; does not start or stop the current Desktop Commander process, modify repositories, or expose credentials.
